text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday according to the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The government assesses its programme at the end of 1996: plain succes in reactivating the economic machinery but unemployement and other social woes still defiant challenges.
- President Liamine Zeroual issues order to government bodies urging enforcement of the law and the constitution.
- The authorities to streamline the agriculture sector through a new listing of farmers.
